name: Cruzeiro do Sul (Brazil)
description: Dark blue field charged with the five white stars of the Southern Cross, offset towards the hoist.
history: Cruzeiro do Sul is a municipality in north-western Acre, Brazil, on the border with Peru. The flag shows the Southern Cross (Cruzeiro do Sul), the municipality's namesake; Flags of the World records this design from the municipal website in 2012, replacing an earlier reported flag.
